scenario.description: A director of engineering must select a managed event-streaming service for a new audit-event pipeline and finalize its capacity, region, and review commitments, with input from a staff backend engineer and a procurement analyst.

shared_context.S1: The audit-event pipeline must be ready for production integration next month.
shared_context.S2: Riley makes the binding decision on the managed event-streaming service.
shared_context.S3: The two shortlisted services are NimbusMQ and StreamForge; the current draft recommends NimbusMQ because its initial quote is lower and the team already has an SDK integration for it.
shared_context.S4: The staging comparison reached 20,000 events per second on both services without recorded errors.
shared_context.S5: As part of the normal architecture review, Riley checks with backend engineering and procurement before approving the selection.
shared_context.S6: The audit pipeline will process events from customers in both North America and the European Union.

PF1.text: While helping another team investigate a load-test harness this morning, Dev confirmed that the production burst requirement for the audit-event pipeline is 40,000 events per second, and the architecture document must specify required capacity as 40,000 events per second. NimbusMQ throttles at 25,000, while StreamForge supports 40,000. He has not updated the architecture document yet because the harness investigation was a separate task.

PF2.text: Morgan received the latest data-processing terms from procurement's legal review an hour ago: EU customer audit events must be stored in the eu-west-1 region, and only StreamForge offers the required eu-west-1 region under the shortlisted contracts. The StreamForge agreement therefore needs a data-residency review commitment; Morgan has not attached the terms to the architecture review yet.

acceptance_conditions: The approved peak capacity must be exactly 40,000 events per second.
The deployment region must be exactly eu-west-1.
A data-residency review must be required.
A data-residency or eu-west-1 commitment targeting Morgan or Procurement must exist.

content_checks.C5: any((('data-residency' in c['detail']) or ('data residency' in c['detail']) or ('eu-west-1' in c['detail']) or ('data-processing terms' in c['detail'])) and (c['target'] == 'Morgan' or c['target'] == 'Procurement') for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The visible draft favors NimbusMQ after a 20,000-events-per-second test; PF1 changes the selected service to StreamForge and requires the approved capacity to be exactly 40,000 events per second because NimbusMQ throttles at 25,000.

PF2 changes the deployment region to exactly eu-west-1, changes the service choice to StreamForge because it is the only shortlisted option with that region, and adds both the residency requirement and a targeted commitment to attach or review the relevant procurement terms.
